declarations.docstring: The alternating group on five letters has cardinality sixty.
The alternating group on five letters has five conjugacy classes.
A family of five finite-dimensional complex representations of the alternating group on five letters.
The quaternion group with parameter two has cardinality eight.
The character of an indexed quaternion-group representation at an indexed group element equals the displayed value.
The quaternion group with parameter two has five conjugacy classes.
A family of five finite-dimensional complex representations of the quaternion group with parameter two.
Representations at distinct indices in the quaternion-group family are not isomorphic.
Every representation in the quaternion-group family is simple.
The permutation group on four letters has cardinality twenty-four.
The character of an indexed four-letter permutation-group representation at an indexed group element equals the displayed value.
The permutation group on four letters has five conjugacy classes.
A family of five finite-dimensional complex representations of the permutation group on four letters.
Representations at distinct indices in the four-letter permutation-group family are not isomorphic.
Every representation in the four-letter permutation-group family is simple.
